slice: R2.6.16 fixture-backed interrupted VaultStore rename recovery
status: accepted slice; R2 remains in progress
scope: Exercise the shared C03 resolved rename fixture through a simulated interrupted transaction, vault reopen and recovery.
behavior: The recovery test materializes the resolved fixture in a temporary vault, records before-images and a prepared rename manifest, moves Old.md to Archive/New.md, and writes the planned reference updates before simulating process interruption.

On reopen, recovery restores every original fixture byte, moves the source back, removes Archive/New.md, appends a rolled_back journal record, reports no needs_attention items and performs no duplicate work when called again.
Nested exact-path lookup now validates each parent component as a directory, rejects symlinks and non-directories, and checks canonical containment beneath the vault root.
No local executable validation was run; all executable validation used GitHub Actions.
